preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 2013, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 2013 for S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: The length of each string S in the test cases is between 1 and 2013, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ?' for c in S) for S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each character in each string S is either a capital letter from 'A' to 'Z' or a question mark '?'.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output) == len(input) for input, output in zip(test_cases, outputs))
postconditions.description: The length of each output string is the same as the length of the corresponding input string.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in output) for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each character in each output string is a capital letter from 'A' to 'Z'.

postconditions.expression: all(output == min(possible_outputs, key=lambda x: (x.count('CHEF'), x)) for input, output in zip(test_cases, outputs))
postconditions.description: Each output string is the lexicographically smallest string that can be obtained from the corresponding input string by replacing question marks with capital letters and having as many substrings equal to 'CHEF' as possible.
